newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps says reaffirms GM rating.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps says reaffirms GM rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it reaffirmed its ratings of General Motors Corp and General Motors Acceptance Corp following an announcement that GM plans to spin off its Hughes defense and aerospace unit and merge it with Raytheon Corp.
The rating for GM's senior debt is Single A Minus and its preference stock is Triple B Plus. GMAC's senior debt also is rated Single A Minus and its commercial paper is rated D One.
In total, about $81 billion of debt was outstanding on September 30, 1996.
